# FIX-ORI-SUITE-2: Repair the foreign suite drifts behind the aggregate's residual failures

## What this does

Repairs the foreign test-suite failures that keep the aggregate `pnpm test` red after the seven-suite repair — each planner-verified STANDALONE on the recorded candidate (`2f15ba41`, byte-identical to trunk `dbf3c0af` for every suite file this task may touch) — and honestly routes the two reported failures that are NOT test drift. Four foreign suites carry real test-side drift or runtime-class damage; the other two of the six reported failures are owner-routed or environmental, and this task does NOT charter a mask for either.

The planner-verified per-suite ledger (every observation below was reproduced by the planner on `2f15ba41` via the exact per-suite selectors preserved in this charter):

1. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts` (ORI-AST-001) — 2 of 4 tokens verified failing FAST (`ORI-AST-001-collection-schema` and `ORI-AST-001-publication-contract` each die at the first scratch build: `'valid build exits 0': expected 1 to be +0` inside ~1.5 s; `ORI-AST-001-mdx-code-copy` was reported failing in the same window and needs the same fixture repair plus a free 4321 for Part A; `ORI-AST-001-prose-navigation` passes). ROOT CAUSE verified by scratch reproduction: `makeScratch()` (docs-collection.test.ts:92-108) mirrors only the root `package.json` plus `apps/docs/**`, but the landed app now references two more repo-root trees — `apps/docs/src/components/TokenTable.astro:5` imports `../../../../scripts/docs-data/token-map` (landed by ORI-AST-003), and the quickstart page's render-time source read opens `packages/docs-snippets/shared/quickstart-messages.ts` (the ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1 tutorial designation), so every scratch build dies `UNRESOLVED_IMPORT` (scripts absent) and then `ENOENT ... quickstart-messages.ts` (render-time). VERIFIED REPAIR: with exactly `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` mirrored into the scratch, the identical scratch `astro build` exits 0 with `Complete!` and emits `dist/docs/collection-reference/index.html`. The repair is the fixture: extend `makeScratch()` to mirror the two root trees, exactly the existing root-`package.json` precedent at docs-collection.test.ts:95.
2. `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts` (FUSE-05) — the full file verified standalone: 1 failed / 3 passed (~11 min; both 900-second build drills pass). The sole failure is `copies public r generated-only and byte-identical` at :323 — `git ls-files apps/docs/public` must be empty, but ORI-VIS-001 (`1c732dc1`) landed five AUTHORED font files under `apps/docs/public/fonts/` (`OFL.txt`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-mono-var-latin.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin-ext.woff2`, `spline-sans-var-latin.woff2`). The 57-per-engine counts, the byte-identity mirror, and every check-ignore assertion above :323 pass unchanged. Repair: scope the tracked-files assertion to the GENERATED subtree — `git ls-files apps/docs/public/r` must be empty — with a supersede comment naming `1c732dc1`; the authored fonts stay tracked by design.
3. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts` (FLOW-DOCS-02) — token `AC-4 pins the hook contract, compiles both graphs and tears down owned children` verified failing standalone at :631 — `expect(hookSource).toContain("from 'expo/fetch'")` is stale since FIX-ORI-AI-001-1 (`755edeae`) moved the hook to the lazy form `const { fetch: expoFetch } = await import('expo/fetch')` at `apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts:46` (the lazy import lets the module load outside Metro). Everything else in the token verified current on the candidate: both `tsc --noEmit` compiles exit 0 (`apps/example/server/tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.live-chat.json`), all four PINS read back exactly (`ai@7.0.89`, `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.92`, `@ai-sdk/openai@4.0.66`, `zod@4.6.1`), and every other hook literal is present (`DefaultChatTransport`, `throttle: 50`, `messages: []` at use-live-chat.ts:203, `clearError();` before `regenerate();` at :20-21). Repair: the one literal takes the current lazy form; every neighboring oracle stays byte-effective.
4. `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts` (ORI-RN-005) — the two marathon tokens (`ORI-RN-005-abort-error-retry` :201, `ORI-RN-005-fail-closed-cleanup` :270, both `timeout: 75 * 60_000`) failed inside the 16-hour aggregate. The recorded run manifests (`.tmp/ORI-RN-005/{abort-error-retry,fail-closed-cleanup}/manifest.json`) show CONCLUDED runs (`teardown.json` written with fresh `finished_at` — 2026-09-26T05:30:49Z and 09:35:21Z) whose legs failed on runtime observations, not assertion drift: iOS `seed turn ended as no terminal record`, Android `"Live chat" never appeared (60s)`, web `growthSamples: []`. The 5-entry source manifest (`nativewind-live-source-manifest.json`) verified hash-current against every mapped source — no drift. RUNTIME CLASS: this task stands both tokens back up STANDALONE in a reserved-device quiet window (real iOS simulator, Android emulator, web export, owned backend, official OpenAI Responses endpoint), and may adjust the per-token budget ONLY on observed timeout-mechanism evidence with the kill-retry arithmetic recorded (`runDriverWithKillRetry` :93-111 doubles any externally-killed run — a 30-35 min full run retried once exceeds nothing at 75 min, but a fail-closed case-3 full run plus a retried leg can; the math must be in the comment and the handoff). A leg failure that reproduces standalone for a PRODUCT reason is a blocked report owner-routed to the ORI-RN-005 surface — never a mask, never a skip, never a lowered assertion.

Owner-routed — NOT chartered for repair: `tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/ci-chain-order.test.ts` (FLOW-DELIV-01). Planner-verified: its FUSE-12 lane AC-1 (the `... ships 112 dist JSONs` token — the 114 current-literal already landed at :246-248 with 57-per-engine at :255) PASSES standalone, and AC-2 (the ci.yml parse proof) PASSES standalone. The suite's only failing token is `FLOW-DELIV-01-ci-chain-order` (:66), which runs the root `pnpm e2e:docs` twice — the full Playwright lane — whose only currently-failing spec token is `recovery-presentation.spec.ts` ac-5 (:745-806): the public-origin prerequisite that hard-throws `PUBLIC PREREQUISITE unmet` until ORI-DEP-002/003 publish the reviewed candidate at the apex (planner probe 2026-09-26: `https://rnraielements.com/<unknown-path>` answers HTTP 404 with an EMPTY body — no branded recovery surface). No test edit can make that token pass before deployment; the file stays outside this task's boundary. The stale `'[data-search-slot] button'` constant at `recovery-presentation.spec.ts:52` is LATENT only — its two uses (:522, :611) are `toBeHidden()` assertions, which are strict-mode-exempt and pass with the close button present — so no repair is chartered there either; report-only.

Environmental — NOT chartered as an assertion change: `tests/sprint-05-orient-search/contributing-content.test.ts` (ORI-CONT-006). Planner-verified 4/4 PASS standalone on the candidate (the `ORI-CONT-006-real-docs-checks` token runs the real build / check:snippets / check:links chain green). Its aggregate failure was the end-of-run tmpdir-reaper cascade that killed 87 collections (~/.cache/agent-scratch vite transform scratch reaped ~16 h in). The remedy this task owns is RUN HYGIENE for the one aggregate rerun: a stable TMPDIR outside the agent-session scratch, recorded in run.json — no edit to the suite.

AGGREGATE REALITY this charter encodes honestly: the vitest aggregate includes ci-chain-order's full-e2e token, Local `pnpm test` and `pnpm e2e:docs` do not collect ORI-VIS-005-ac-5. That check is mandatory only after publication, via `pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/sprint-05-orient-search/publication.playwright.config.ts`, and it is not this task's verify command. AC-3 therefore defines an attributed-residual gate: the aggregate is run ONCE (never harness-spawned), its complete failing inventory is recorded, and every suite outside a named residual closure must be green in-aggregate. Nothing residual is silent.

## Why

The in-flight seven-suite repair landed all seven chartered repairs and proved them green in isolation, then blocked honestly on its aggregate clause: six foreign suites fail on the candidate through no fault of those repairs (cycle-1 blocked report, recorded 2026-09-26; wave-21 decision). This task owns the four of those six that are test-side drift or runtime-class damage — each planner-verified standalone in this planning pass, with the two non-drift failures routed to their owners instead of masked — so the aggregate's residual failure set collapses to exactly the deployment-gated closure that ORI-DEP-002/003 own. The owning tasks of the drifted suites (ORI-AST-001, FUSE-05/FLOW-DELIV-01, ORI-AI-001, ORI-RN-005, ORI-CONT-006) are all completed; the drift is collateral of landed, reviewed sprint-05 work (ORI-AST-003's token-map import, ORI-CONT-003/FIX-ORI-CI-001-1's render-time snippet read, ORI-VIS-001's authored fonts, FIX-ORI-AI-001-1's lazy expo/fetch import) and of the 16-hour serialized aggregate environment.

## How to verify

```sh
pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/foreign-suite-repair-proof.test.ts
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm exec biome ci tests/sprint-05-orient-search/docs-collection.test.ts tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/docs-data-prebuild.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example-api.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts tests/sprint-05-orient-search/foreign-suite-repair-proof.test.ts
```

The first command is the exact selector: the task-owned proof harness spawns each named per-suite selector (the three drifted vitest suites, the live-example-api AC-4 token, and the two NativeWind marathon tokens with per-child timeouts sized to their real envelopes), asserts exit 0 for each, runs `pnpm typecheck` and the scoped Biome command, and asserts the tracked-file diff boundary — recording RED (the planner-verified standalone failures above, bound to the pre-change candidate SHA) and GREEN (per-selector exit 0) in `.tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-2/`. `pnpm test` (the aggregate vitest run), `pnpm typecheck`, and the scoped Biome command are preserved GREEN commands the implementer runs and records in `run.json`; the harness never spawns the aggregate (a vitest child spawning the vitest aggregate would re-run every drill and the harness — unbounded recursion).

## Scope

Own exactly the four named test files, the task-owned proof harness, drill-emitted evidence writes, and bounded `.tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-2/` evidence. Zero product-source changes: the docs-collection fixture repair COPIES `scripts/` and `packages/docs-snippets/` into its owned scratch and never edits the originals; `apps/**`, `packages/**`, and `scripts/**` on the candidate stay byte-unchanged. The two non-drift failures stay outside the boundary: ci-chain-order.test.ts and recovery-presentation.spec.ts are owner-routed to ORI-DEP-002/003 (report-only), and contributing-content.test.ts is verified green standalone (run-hygiene only, no edit).
